identity.name: Odysseus
identity.one_liner: Lange's first stainless-steel, bracelet-equipped sports watch, launched in October 2019 after roughly a decade of internal development.

waitlist_evidence.description: Nine months after launch, Monochrome Watches reported that finding a new steel Odysseus at retail price from a boutique had become 'quite challenging,' citing demand outpacing supply.
Langepedia noted the steel Odysseus entering the pre-owned auction market in May 2021 already starting from the high $80,000s against a roughly $35,000 retail price.

provenance_events.description: A. Lange & Söhne unveiled the Odysseus on 24 October 2019, its first stainless-steel sports watch with an integrated bracelet, ending years of speculation about whether the brand would enter the category.

narrative.story: Lange had resisted the steel sports-watch category through the genre's post-2016 boom, and the Odysseus arrived in October 2019 as the brand's answer: a stainless-steel case and bracelet on an automatic movement, functions and finishing kept to Lange's usual standard rather than simplified for the segment. Coming from a manufacture whose output runs a fraction of its steel-sports-watch rivals, the model was oversubscribed at boutiques within its first year.
narrative.collector_notes: Dial color is the primary variant to track; the original blue, black, and grey dials each carry different waitlist dynamics at retail. Bracelet fit and the day-and-date module at 12 o'clock are the details buyers check most closely against catalog photos before ordering.
